services.name: Boat Rentals
services.desc: Rent a tritoon or fishing boat on Table Rock Lake in Shell Knob, MO. Our 23-foot Landau tritoons seat 12 and pack a 140hp motor with plenty of muscle for tubing, cruising, or kicking back on the water. Book by the half-day or the week (4 hours to 14 days). Reserve yours today. - All boat drivers must be 21 or older. A valid photo ID is required at check-in.- Missouri Boater Safety certification is required for any driver born on or after January 1, 1984. You can complete this course online at boat-ed.com before your rental date.- Passengers of all ages are welcome - the 21+ and safety certification requirements apply only to the person operating the boat. - All boats are priced per boat,

blurb: Kings River Marina offers annual wet slip rentals and boat lift rentals for boats of various sizes on the quieter side of Table Rock Lake. They rent 23-foot Landau tritoons and fishing boats with 140hp motors for durations from 4 hours up to 14 days. The marina also provides emergency boat towing, fuel, groceries, and merchandise for boating needs.
